target.title: fix(google): bound batch create error body read
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`response.text()` in the Gemini batch create non-404 error path embeds the
full response body in the Error message.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replaced raw `response.text()` + `throw Error` with `createProviderHttpError`
for non-404 errors. Preserves 404 diagnostic message. Pattern from #102953.

## User Impact

**Before:** unbounded body in error message
**After:** bounded + redacted via `createProviderHttpError`

## Evidence

### Targeted path proof (Gemini batch-create via createProviderHttpError)

Real HTTP 400 with sensitive Google API error body → `createProviderHttpError(response, "gemini.batch-create")`:

```
=== #103472 Proof: createProviderHttpError on Gemini batch-create path ===
Error name ProviderHttpError: PASS
Status 400: PASS
Label "gemini.batch-create": PASS
Status in message: PASS
API_KEY_INVALID not in message: PASS
Raw JSON not in message: PASS
Service domain not in message: PASS
Structured code INVALID_ARGUMENT: PASS
Error body bounded: PASS

Message: gemini.batch-create (400): The API key included in the request is invalid. [code=INVALID_ARGUMENT]
Code: INVALID_ARGUMENT
Status: 400

Overall: ALL PASS
```

### Tests

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/google/embedding-batch.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
```

### Diff

```
extensions/google/embedding-batch.ts | 3 +-- (createProviderHttpError)
```

- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns

@clawsweeper re-review
